post.description: ADMIN or STAFF owning/assigned to the RUNNING Job. Purpose must match the AUTHENTICATE Step. Only STAFF_CONFIRMATION is supported here; QR_CODE requires a separate proof verifier. Same actor retry returns the existing unexpired grant without extending its TTL. Scope violations return 403.

post.summary: Đăng nhập tài khoản đã ACTIVE
Create Workflow and complete graph atomically
Create a planned Shift and its Slots atomically
Run retention; dry-run is the safe default
Store a generated heatmap; does not run an AI algorithm
